notes: Both sources simulate a Nequi Negocios wallet node. They are not a real Nequi signal.
They share one Ed25519 key, generated by the backend at startup and never committed. The source id, not the key, sets the trust level.

camara-fixture simulates the Cámara de Comercio behind FixtureCamaraVerifier (data/seeds/camara). It records the Cámara's CIIU codes for a NIT, and binds a NIT to a PayPal account only when the certificate email is the account email proven by Log in with PayPal. A pull source: no key.
